narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One ninth is greater, because nine is bigger than five.
<bookmark mark='lay'/>Lay one ninth piece on top of one fifth piece, and look closely at the edges.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>It covers only part of the fifth, so the ninth piece is the smaller one.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>The same whole shared by more people gives each person a smaller fractional unit.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn, which is greater, one seventh of a roti or one tenth of a roti?
